{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Missing step in funnel report across multiple occasions in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py (analytics side)

Common characteristics across all occasions:
- File affected: analytics/dashboards/funnel.py
- Problem: Missing step in the funnel report
- Standard repro: Build the funnel for the two-week window
- Consistent error signal: A stage with zero users between two populated ones
- All work in the same corner of analytics/dashboards/funnel.py; context carried over between fixes
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/analytics/test_funnel.py

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-23] - config loader bug
- Trigger: Only appeared for clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #1600 on branch fix/missing-step-1
- Measured outcome: Flaky test went from 22 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2 [2026-01-30] - cache invalidation bug
- Trigger: Only appeared when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: A cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #2059 on branch fix/missing-step-2
- Measured outcome: Reclaimed 55 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-01] - N+1 query bug
- Trigger: Only appeared for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: An N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #2694 on branch fix/missing-step-3
- Measured outcome: 86 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 4 [2026-04-06] - exception handling bug
- Trigger: Only appeared for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: An error swallowed by a bare except
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #3312 on branch fix/missing-step-4
- Measured outcome: Cold start dropped 46 percent, to 459 ms

OCCASION 5 [2026-06-05] - transaction boundary bug
- Trigger: Only appeared for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #4056 on branch fix/missing-step-5
- Measured outcome: The nightly rollup matched the source counts for 91 days running

OCCASION 6 [2026-07-22] - connection pool bug
- Trigger: Only appeared on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #7447 on branch fix/missing-step-6
- Measured outcome: Throughput rose 67 percent, to 273 requests per second"}
